gloss: to take off; to fly away; to set out

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {飛|と}び{立|た}ちませんでした

forms.negative: {飛|と}び{立|た}っていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {飛|と}び{立|た}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to take off; to fly away; to take flight
definitions.explanation: A bird, insect, or aircraft lifts off from the ground or a perch and begins to fly.

definitions.gloss: to set out; to depart; to embark on a journey
definitions.explanation: To leave a place with energy and purpose, especially to start a new venture or journey. A figurative extension of the flying meaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白鳥|はくちょう}→白鳥：04937_hakuchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{立|た}った。
examples.english: The swans all took off from the lake at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{滑走路|かっそうろ}→滑走路：05980_kassouro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧、⟦やがて→やがて：03637_yagate⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{飛|と}び{立|た}った。
examples.english: The plane ran down the runway and soon took off into the sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{飛|と}び{立|た}つ。
examples.english: To set out into a new world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{飛|と}び{立|た}つ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧たち。
examples.english: Young people graduating and setting out into society.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{飛|と}び{立|た}つ⟦{決心|けっしん}→決心：02700_kesshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: With dreams in my heart, I resolved to leave my hometown and set out on my own.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (to fly) + ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand/rise). The combination emphasizes the upward launching motion of taking flight.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{飛|と}び{立|た}つ — to take off into the sky
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{飛|と}び{立|た}つ — to set out into the world
- ⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{立|た}つ — to take flight all at once

USAGE:
Sense 1 is literal and used for birds and aircraft. Sense 2 is figurative and commonly appears in graduation speeches, motivational contexts, and stories about leaving home to pursue one's dreams.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ — to fly (general; {飛|と}び{立|た}つ emphasizes the moment of departure)
- ⟦{旅立|たびだ}つ→旅立つ：12951_tabidatsu⟧ — to depart on a journey (focuses on the journey itself, not the flying image)
- ⟦{離陸|りりく}する→離陸する：22506_ririkusuru⟧ — to take off (technical/aviation term)
